output.summary: KEP-3983 adds a --config-dir flag to the kubelet so that drop-in .conf files in a directory are merged, in alphanumeric order, over the base kubelet configuration. The KEP is marked implemented and stage stable.
output.rationale: Kubelet configuration is often managed by several entities, and editing one shared file causes races and overwrites. Drop-in files let each owner manage its own file, following a common Linux pattern. The design was accepted with the flag empty by default, so drop-in support is opt-in, and dynamic reconfiguration of a running kubelet was explicitly kept out of scope.

alternatives.option: Reinstate the now deprecated Dynamic Kubelet Configuration
alternatives.why_not: Listed as an alternative in the readme; the sources say the project was moving away from dynamic kubelet config, so the drop-in approach was chosen instead.

alternatives.option: Continue to rely on CLI flags or systemd drop-in files
alternatives.why_not: Listed as an alternative in the readme; the sources do not give a detailed reason for rejecting it.
Discussion moved to an empty default to align with --config; sergeykanzhelev later asked whether a default was needed, and the sources do not record a final resolution beyond the readme's beta plan.

alternatives.option: Keep the flag gated only by the KUBELET_CONFIG_DROPIN_DIR_ALPHA environment variable
alternatives.why_not: The readme says the environment variable is removed in beta; reviewers also asked for a feature gate to prevent accidental alpha use, and a feature gate was added.

evidence.quote: The flag will be empty by default and if not specified, drop-in support will not be enabled.
As part of this optimization, we will remove the `KUBELET_CONFIG_DROPIN_DIR_ALPHA` environment variable, simplifying configuration management.
